mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing metabolism of prochlorperazine and increasing its plasma concentration; additive anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, anticholinergic effects); consider dose adjustment or alternative antiemetic if excessive effects occur.
